body:
## Change

F1. Cache highest-rarity lookup per readonly ShopSetData identity in WeakMap. Avoid rescanning every set for every owned card on Sell. Preserve rarity ranking and catalog/common fallback.

## Validation

V1. Parent reviewed snapshot construction, lookup/fallback equivalence, and reran indexing regression. Worker measured cold 4,654-code sweep: 26.1645 ms to 0.7123 ms on shipped 50-set snapshot; Node measurement, not browser-frame benchmark. Related: 120; contracts: 87 passed. Typecheck, targeted lint/format and diff checks pass.

## Limits

L1. Unsupported in-place mutation retains cached index; production creates replacement readonly snapshots. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: perf(story): index shop rarities for sale browsing
